name: Shuhah
title: Descendant of Caleb
summary: Shuhah was a son of Caleb through his concubine Maacah. He is mentioned in Chronicles as the ancestor of Jerahmeel. Shuhah is part of the genealogy of the tribe of Judah and helps to show the rich family history of Caleb's family.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Caleb's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Shuhah is mentioned as one of the sons of Caleb through his concubine Maacah, as part of the detailed family history of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's descendants through Maacah
keyEvents.description: Maacah, Caleb's concubine, bore several sons including Shuah, showing the spread of Caleb's lineage in the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of the genealogy of the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Shuah is placed within the broader context of the tribe of Judah's family record, tracing the descendants of Israel through Judah and further through Caleb.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's faithful inheritance
keyEvents.description: As descendants of Caleb, the faithful spy who followed the Lord wholeheartedly, Shuah and his siblings carry forward an important lineage in Israel's history.
